snippet.title: Bunch of Regular Guys Make This Commercial
snippet.description:
Meet Our Best Razor Ever: Our newest product, launched entirely by the people who use it.
At Dollar Shave Club, we’ve always believed shaving shouldn’t suck. From day one, we disrupted the shaving industry by putting power back into the hands of real people. Now, with the launch of our best razor ever, we’re taking that mission even further. This isn’t just another razor. This is a razor designed, inspired, and launched with the help of the people who know shaving best—our members.
That’s right. For the first time ever, we flipped the script and gave our community full creative control. Instead of big ad agencies and glossy marketing playbooks, we turned to the people who actually use our products every single day. The result? The Order of The Blade—our out-house agency made up entirely of real Dollar Shave Club members.
These aren’t actors. They’re not marketers. They’re real guys with real opinions about what makes a shave great. They sat in the driver’s seat for this launch—writing ad copy, brainstorming billboard ideas, directing commercial scripts, even coming up with jingles. They shared insights on what collaborations would actually matter, what stunts would grab attention, and what perks they want to see next as loyal members of the Club.
And together, they helped us bring to life our best razor yet.
What Makes This Razor Different?
We listened. We tested. We obsessed over every detail. And with input from our members, we built a razor that delivers the closest, most comfortable shave we’ve ever offered.
Longer-Lasting Blades – Longer-lasting stainless steel blades. How? Science.
Juicy Lubricating Strip –A lube strip so packed with Aloe and Vitamin E, every shave has a happy ending.
Affordable as Always – The best part? All of these upgrades come at the exact same price you’re used to. Because a better shave shouldn’t come with a bigger bill.
Built By Members, For Members

snippet.description:

4. Shave, preferably with a fresh blade. The butter is clear, so you can see where you’re going.

5. Enjoy your buttery smooth skin.

snippet.title: How to Shave: Tips for Getting the Best Shave from Dollar Shave Club
snippet.description:
Shaving is easy if you know how —  here are some tips to get the best shave of your life: 

1. Wash your face with warm water and a good exfoliating prep scrub to remove any gunk — including dirt and dead skin cells — that would otherwise clog up your blade. Alternatively, you can use a hot towel to soften up your whiskers and open your pores, making it easier for the razor to glide smoothly across your face and effortlessly slice through the hairs.

2. Choose a shave product that’ll lubricate your skin and soften the hairs without drying out your face. The type of shave aid you use is down to personal preference: Shave cream is traditional for a pillowy, smooth shave, but those who want to be able to see where they’re shaving more clearly — if, for example, they’re experimenting with some different beard styles — may want to try a soft, transparent shave butter instead.

3. It’s vital to know how to shave with the grain (especially around the crease of the neck), as it helps to prevent razor burn, skin irritation and ingrown hair (if you try to go against the grain and discover that your skin generally isn’t prone to irritation, then shaving this way is certainly a one-way trip to Smooth City — just be aware that this isn’t true for most people.)

4. For cheeks as smooth as a baby’s bottom, make your razor strokes long and apply a consistent amount of pressure.

5. A shave isn’t over when you put the razor down — proper aftercare soothes your skin when it needs it most. Since shaving is a natural exfoliant, make sure you always apply a gentle alcohol-free post shave cream afterwards to put back what you took out by shaving. This will help to soothe, nourish and hydrate your skin.

6. Check it out! You’re even more handsome now that you can actually see your own face! And all it took was a few basics: The right preparation, knowing how to shave with the grain, and how to care for your skin afterwards. We told you it’s easy when you know how.

Check out more helpful videos in the Dollar Shave Club How To Library of How To’s here on YouTube, or head to DollarShaveClub.com.
